title: Claude Code: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects
summary: A project is one long-running coordinating conversation that starts a thread (usually a cloud session) for each task and tracks them. Its Overview pane groups threads by state: Ready for review, Waiting on you, Working, Landing, Idle, Resolved, with Library, Pull requests and Scheduled tasks tabs; a thread card's buttons send 'Resolve conflicts', 'Fix CI', 'Address comments' or 'Merge it' to the thread. Project instructions (up to 16,000 characters) and project memory reach every thread. Cloud threads load each repository's root CLAUDE.md but not its skills, .claude/settings.json, hooks, agents, commands or .mcp.json; plugins come from Project settings, skills from the account. Public beta on Pro, Max and Ultra, rolling out; not on Team or Enterprise yet. Works at claude.ai/code, in the Desktop Code tab and on the phone.
ideas: This is D-43's shape built in: one coordinator, a thread per piece of work, one pane of what needs you.
Waiting on you is a state the product computes from the thread, not from a record.
The coordinator sees what threads report back, not every step; standing context lives in project instructions and memory.
Threads do not run a repository's hooks or skills, so avenCEO's later Stop hook would not run there.
It knows threads, not intents: no stage, tasks or gates.

took.idea: Overview's groups as the model for the intent view
